name: gap_fill_stall_001_5s
author: adapted from gpt-5.4
thesis: This strategy exploits intraday partial gap reversion after an overnight move stalls against session flow and fails to extend beyond the early range. The inefficiency exists because pre-open price discovery is coarse and traders overreact to overnight headlines, and it persists because gap behavior is noisy and quickly stops working on real repricing days.
mechanism: The opening range concentrates pending orders and stop-losses on both sides. When price breaches the range boundary, stop-loss orders from wrong-side participants cascade, amplifying the move. Breakout-following algorithms detect the breach and add momentum, creating a self-reinforcing move that typically persists for 60-180 seconds before the order book absorbs the flow.

exit.signal_exit: exit when price fills to vwap OR re-breaks opening-range extreme

weaknesses: Performance is regime-dependent and weakens materially when session structure changes mid-trade.
Fast moves can create worse-than-assumed slippage and reduce realized edge versus paper assumptions.
Crowding risk can compress payoff and make execution quality unstable in the most obvious setups.
prior_art: Gap fade / failed opening-range breakout / VWAP fill
adaptation_notes: Converted from 1min to 5s bars. Lookback multiplier: 12x. Adaptations: timeframe scaling to 5-second candles; signal conversion from individual stock to NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index; lookback period scaling for 5-second bars; stop/target recalibration for 5-second timeframe. Stop/target calibrated for options point-based exits. Universe narrowed to NIFTY index.
